title: Adobe Modern - House with Private Pool
description: Luxe Modern Retreat w/ Casita, Pool, Hot Tub & Game Spaces
review_snippets: Awesome house for a large group. The outdoor area was great. Pool and lots of seating spaces. Communication was straight forward. Really enjoyed that the checkout process was simple as well.

We enjoyed our stay.  The home was beautiful and clean and offered everything we needed from comfort to downtime entertainment. We stayed at this location with a sports team and the girls loved it.  The gathering space provided plenty of room for us all to enjoy time together.

Came down for a golf trip with 7 buddies. There was plenty of space to sleep us all and fit us all comfortably! Overall the house worked out great for us. It was a beautiful area, felt safe as well! It suited well for our group and would recommend for a bigger group like ours!
